hooks.command: if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git add -A && MSG=$(git diff --cached --stat --no-color | tail -1 | sed 's/^ *//' | sed 's/,//g'); FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | head -5 | sed 's|.*/||' | paste -sd ', ' -); git commit -m "update ${FILES}" -m "${MSG}"; fi; git pull --rebase 2>/dev/null; git push 2>/dev/null
